# StrainEase

> StrainEase helps medical cannabis patients compare strains for their symptoms, aggregating research from Leafly, Weedmaps, Reddit, Google, and dispensary menus.

StrainEase is a medical-cannabis research product for patients. It is not a dispensary, not a doctor, and not medical advice. Content summarizes commonly reported patient experience from public sources.

## Site

- [Home](https://strainease.ai/): Product overview, how matching works, and popular strains
- [Full catalog for language models](https://strainease.ai/llms-full.txt): Structured strain and terpene notes
- [Sitemap](https://strainease.ai/sitemap.xml)

## Terpene pages

- [Myrcene](https://strainease.ai/terpene/myrcene): Earthy. Often linked with body heaviness and easier sleep.
- [Limonene](https://strainease.ai/terpene/limonene): Citrus. Commonly described as mood-lifting and daytime-friendly.
- [Caryophyllene](https://strainease.ai/terpene/caryophyllene): Peppery. Patients often mention it for stress and body tension.
- [Pinene](https://strainease.ai/terpene/pinene): Pine. Associated with a clearer, more alert head.
- [Linalool](https://strainease.ai/terpene/linalool): Floral. Frequently reported as calming.
- [Terpinolene](https://strainease.ai/terpene/terpinolene): Herbal-citrus. Often a brighter, more stimulating profile.
- [Humulene](https://strainease.ai/terpene/humulene): Hoppy. Sometimes noted as appetite-dampening.
- [Ocimene](https://strainease.ai/terpene/ocimene): Sweet-herbal. Usually described as uplifting.
